title: "Can you re-apply after getting rejected?"
transcript: Getting rejected for a job does not mean you can never work at that company. Unfortunately, we don't always get to know why we were rejected. Somebody else could have just applied earlier, breezed through the whole process, and then they only were hiring one role. That's not on you. Maybe the company did see a misalignment between what you were saying you were looking for and what they were offering, in which case I would hope they would actually let you know. And if it was something like maybe not enough experience, you're going to get more of that as you work more. Maybe you go somewhere else for a year or two. If that company relists that position, it's absolutely worth applying.
